newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Elan, Jannsen developing daily compound.
newsitem.headline: Elan, Jannsen developing daily compound.

text.p: Pharmaceutical group Elan Corporation said in a statement on Monday it was working with Jannsen Pharmaceutica to develop a once-daily version "of a major Jannsen compound."
Jannsen is an affiliate of Johnson & Johnson.
Elan said in a statement that the two firms had signed a licence to regulate commercialisation of the product and phase III trials would begin next year.

"We are very pleased to have the opportunity to provide drug delivery technology to Jannsen and in particular to be involved with a major Jannsen compound," Elan president and CEO Donal Geaney said in a statement.
"This agreement is another important step in helping us realise our objective of being the leading provider of drug delivery technology to the pharmaceutical industry," he said.
